title: Echo
blurb: A blind cave guide finds her way by sound. So do the things hunting her.
howTo:
Sound is how you see: footsteps, claps (Space), tongue clicks (F) and thrown stones (click) light up the cave.
Sound is how you're found: Listeners hunt anything they hear. Hold Shift to sneak.
Follow the exit's wind. E takes a tourist's hand. Esc pauses, R retries.

title: Short Rope
blurb: Co-op climbing with real rope work. One friend leads and clips; the other feeds slack and catches the falls.
howTo:
Climb one limb at a time: hold the left or right mouse button, drag a hand to a hold, let go to grab. Q and E step your feet up.
Clip each quickdraw with F, and call "Clipping!" first so your belayer gives slack.
Belaying: hold ↓ to feed slack, ↑ to take in, Enter to catch a fall.
Solo, a bot belays you. On one computer, the mouse climbs and the arrow keys belay. In a room, up to 4 friends take turns.

title: Tap Test
blurb: The starter template. Tap fast alone, or tap together in a room to check connections.
howTo:
Solo: tap as many times as you can in 10 seconds.
In a room: everyone's taps show up live. The host can reset or finish the round.
